title: 第1609章 鱼篓子第1608章 局势升级
content_zh:
混乱之地，两大仙君府的战斗还在继续，且愈演愈烈，有全面开战的趋势。
双方都投入了大量的高手，参与到战场上。
至于双方的战场，当然是混乱之地。
这一片区域，本来就是两大仙君府之间的缓冲地带。
一直以来，双方若是发生冲突，这里就是战场，这是双方早就默认的规则。
不过，战斗的双方没有发现，最近混乱之地也出现了一些微妙的变化。
就是在战斗中被波及而死亡的人，突然变少了很多。
战斗双方，他们的眼里只有对面强大的仙君府修士。
至于在战斗中踩死了几只蝼蚁，或者没有踩死蝼蚁，并不是他们需要关注的重点。
只有二狗子等人知道，这一切全靠那一整套镜子传讯。
张三将这套360面镜子组成的大阵，命名为“周天万界传讯阵”
凡处于这座周天万界传讯阵笼罩范围之内，所有的情报，都能迅速传递到任何一个角落。
墨羽手下的情报人员，早就散布于整个混乱之地。
甚至连两大仙君府的地盘，也有她布置的眼线。
如今把这360面镜子分布于各个角落，可以随时了解到两大仙君府修士的去向。
往往根据双方修士行进的轨迹，就能预测到他们即将发生战斗的地点。
甚至连仙君府修士自己都不知道，将会在什么地方战斗，但二狗子却提前知道了。
他就可以通过传讯，让那一片区域的修士，提前躲避，减少伤亡。
自从有了这座传讯大阵，被战乱波及而死的修士，起码减少了一半。
想要完全避免，那是不可能的。

就算知道了情报，知道他们将要战斗的地点，也无济于事。
人力有时尽，有太多的无可奈何，比如，实力不够的，根本就跑不动，比如，有时无处可逃……
对此，二狗子也没有更好的办法了。
关键还是实力不如人。
他最近把情报调度传递这些事，都交给了墨羽。
此时二狗子静坐于密室之中，在开始修炼之前，他手里出现一只竹篮。
上次捡到杏花一只储物袋和一只竹篮子，他因为操心战场之事，还没来得及仔细看。
首先是这只竹篮子，杏花经常提在手里的一件宝物。
此物以一种仙竹丝篾，用很高超的手法编织而成，算是一件仙器。
二狗子上次就尝试过使用，这件仙器能够防御，也能困人，就是攻击力很一般。
但能用于防御和困人就很不错了。
只是此物特征太过明显，这种东西属于赃物，他不敢拿出来用。
估计想低价卖出去，脱手都很难。
暂时将竹篮放在一边，又开始查看杏花的储物袋。
他破开储物袋外面的简易封印阵法，神识往里面扫了一眼。
这一眼，可把二狗子吓了一跳。
这只储物袋内部的空间很大，就相当于一座大仓库了。
里面堆积了很多物品，都分类收纳得很整齐。
其中，灵石一堆，装满了十口大箱子，粗略估计里面有两千万灵石。
仙石一堆，装了四口箱子。

一品仙石两箱，共六千多块。
content_en:
In the chaotic land, the battle between the two Immortal Lords' Mansion continues, and becomes more and more intense, with the tendency of a full-scale war.
Both sides have invested a large number of experts on the battlefield.
As for the battlefield on both sides, it is of course a place of chaos.
This area was originally the buffer zone between the two Immortal Lords' Mansion.
All along, if there is a conflict between the two sides, this is the battlefield. This is the rule that both sides have long accepted.
However, the two sides of the battle did not notice that there had been some subtle changes in the chaotic land recently.
The number of people who were affected and died during the battle suddenly decreased a lot.
On both sides of the battle, they only have eyes for the powerful monks from the Immortal Lord Mansion on the other side.
As for how many ants were trampled to death during the battle, or whether there were no ants trampled to death, it was not the focus that they needed to pay attention to.
Only Er Gouzi and others knew that all this relied on a set of mirrors for communication.
Zhang San named this large array of 360 mirrors "Zhoutian Wanjie Communication Array"
Anyone within the coverage of this Zhoutian Ten Thousand Worlds Communication Array can quickly transmit all information to any corner.
Mo Yu's intelligence personnel have long been scattered throughout the chaotic land.
Even the territory of the two Immortal Lords' Mansion has her spy.
Now with these 360 ​​mirrors distributed in every corner, you can know the whereabouts of the monks of the two Immortal Lord Mansion at any time.
Often based on the trajectory of the monks on both sides, the location where they are about to fight can be predicted.
Even the monks from the Immortal Lord Mansion themselves didn't know where they would fight, but Ergouzi knew it in advance.
He can send a message to the monks in that area to escape in advance to reduce casualties.
Since the establishment of this communication formation, the number of monks who died due to the war has been reduced by at least half.
It's impossible to avoid it completely.
Even if they knew the information and where they were going to fight, it would be of no use.
Sometimes manpower is exhausted, and there are too many helplessness. For example, those who are not strong enough cannot run away at all. For example, sometimes there is nowhere to escape...
Ergouzi had no better way to deal with this.
The key is that the strength is not as good as others.
He recently handed over all matters such as intelligence dispatch and transmission to Mo Yu.
At this time, Ergouzi was sitting quietly in the secret room. Before starting to practice, a bamboo basket appeared in his hand.
The last time he picked up a storage bag and a bamboo basket from Xinghua, he didn't have time to take a closer look because he was worried about the battlefield.
The first is this bamboo basket, a treasure that Xinghua often carries in her hand.
This thing is made of a kind of fairy bamboo silk strips, woven with a very superb technique. It can be regarded as an fairy weapon.
Ergouzi tried to use it last time. This magical weapon can defend and trap people, but its attack power is very average.
But it would be great if it could be used for defense and trapping people.
It's just that the characteristics of this object are too obvious. This kind of thing is stolen and he doesn't dare to take it out and use it.
It is estimated that even if you want to sell it at a low price, it will be difficult to get rid of it.
Putting the bamboo basket aside for the time being, she started looking at Xinghua's storage bag again.
He broke the simple sealing formation on the outside of the storage bag and glanced inside.
This sight shocked Er Gouzi.
The space inside this storage bag is very large, equivalent to a large warehouse.
There are many items piled inside, all neatly sorted.
Among them, there was a pile of spiritual stones, filled with ten large boxes, and it was roughly estimated that there were 20 million spiritual stones in them.
There is a pile of fairy stones and four boxes.
There are two boxes of first-grade immortal stones, totaling more than 6,000 pieces.
